1.

The instant revision petition under Section 397/401 Cr.P.C. has been preferred by the petitioners aggrieved by the order dated 28.2.2013 passed by learned Additional Sessions Judge No.2,
Hanumangarh in Sessions Case No.44/12 whereby learned trial court took cognizance of the offences punishable under Section 304B and 498A IPC against the petitioners and issued arrest warrant.

2. Learned counsel for the petitioner does not press the other grounds raised in the revision petition challenging the impugned order taking cognizance, however, made a limited prayer that the [2024:RJ-JD:22503] (2 of 2) [CRLR-187/2013] arrest warrant issued against the petitioners vide the order impugned may be converted into bailable warrant.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned Public Prosecutor opposed the prayer made by the counsel for the petitioner.

4. Having regard to the facts and circumstances of the present case and the fact that proceedings are held up in the matter, it is deemed appropriate that the arrest warrant issued against the petitioners by the trial court is converted into bailable warrant.
The trial court is directed to secure the presence of the accused- petitioners by issuing bailable warrant in the sum of Rs.25,000/- each.

If the petitioners fail to appear before the trial court in pursuance of the bailable warrant as aforesaid, it will be open for the trial court to secure the presence of the petitioners by arrest warrant.
5. The order dated 28.2.2013 passed by the learned trial court is modified accordingly.
The criminal revision petition is accordingly disposed of.
Stay application also stands disposed of.
